games.name: Word Bomb
games.desc:
💣 Inspired by BombParty on JKLM!
👋 A major update to Word Bomb is coming soon. Enable notifications and follow the group for more details.

📚 COMMANDS
To see a list of all commands, visit this link:
https://devforum.roblox.com/t/commands/3025377

🙂 Please do not be mad at others for helping people or using Google, learning is encouraged, and it is NOT cheating!

🎮 It's a pass-it-on bomb game! Type words containing specific letters to pass the bomb on to somebody else.
The bomb ticks faster and faster the longer a round goes on. The last man standing wins!

👍 Good for learning new words, quick typing skills, reaction time, and for obtaining very high IQ.

games.name: The Intruder
games.desc:
You are alone in your house. Suddenly, the phone rings. The police department issues a warning that a criminal is on the loose. Unfortunately, the criminal has a new target: YOU. Check the cameras in your room to watch his every move. He can sometimes enter your room to look for you. Hide in the closet if he does and turn off the lights. Wait until the phone regains service.

Updates: Fixed lever bug in hospital chapter.

Controls:
Flashlight: [PC: F, Gamepad: Y]
Sprint (For Mineshaft): [PC: Left-Shift, Gamepad: B]
Skill-Checks: [PC: E, Gamepad: A] 
Objective: [PC: Q] 

Inspirations: The Mandela Catalogue and Five Nights at Freddy's (also a few other games)

🔺WARNING🔺: This game includes flashing lights, loud sounds, and jumpscares.

Tags: horror, scary, fnaf, intruder, cameras, monster, ghost, mandela

games.name: Feed Your Teto
games.desc:
🥖 Welcome to Feed Your Teto! 🥖

Kasane Teto is here, and she is VERY hungry! In this fun and addictive incremental simulator, your goal is simple: feed Teto as many snacks as possible and watch her literally GROW to massive proportions!

[UPD] The latest update probably contains several bugs or unrealistic statistics. Please leave feedback in my group.

🎮 HOW TO PLAY:
👆 CLICK Teto to feed her snacks and earn money!
🏭 BUILD your own snack farm to automate your food production!
📈 UPGRADE your buildings, workers, and click power to get rich faster!
🔄 REBIRTH to earn powerful permanent multipliers and become unstoppable!
🌍 EXPAND your territory as Teto reaches new levels of happiness!

✨ FEATURES:

Unlock Utaus and Vocaloids to help deliver food!

Watch Teto get bigger and bigger as you progress!

💖 Do you have what it takes to satisfy Teto's infinite hunger?
👍 Don't forget to LIKE and FAVORITE the game to support future updates!

🔖 Tags: Tycoon, Simulator, Clicker, Incremental
